how_to_read: A twin is a starting point, not an answer. Diff it against the stub's assembly before copying: sibling overlays routinely differ by one constant or one branch, and copying past that difference produces a function that is wrong in a way the build will catch but a reviewer will not. A twin under src/st/<name>.h is a SHARED implementation, so the right answer there is usually a shim, not a copy -- check shim_viable() in codebase_index.py first.
